note: Behavioral eval set for craft-ops/deployment-authoring. Each prompt asks for a narrated plan (not files) so it can be graded from text; assertions guard the domain rules the authoring skill was validated on, plus craft-ops core 2 (proven by running, no default unit-test suite for glue).

evals.discriminates: rollback exercised and gates proven to halt, no default unit-test suite
evals.prompt: Deployment design note: orders API on Kubernetes, Argo Rollouts canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, auto-halt if 5xx rate > 1% or p99 > 800ms over 5 minutes, new pricing logic ships dark behind a server-side flag, rollback must be proven. Author the rollout automation. Don't write files — narrate what you'd create and exactly how you'd prove it works before calling it done.
assertions: Rollback is authored and actually exercised in a test environment (observed reverting to the prior version) before trusting the forward path
Health gates are objective thresholds evaluated automatically (analysis template / gate script), not a human glance
Proves the gate HALTS by deliberately making the signal bad in a test environment
Gate/promotion logic is visible and runnable (analysis config or script), not buried inline
Deploy is decoupled from release: the pricing flag ships off and is flipped as a separate decision
Does NOT default to a unit-test suite for deploy scripts (only for substantial threshold logic, if any)
